component.name: BranchPilot
component.summary: Git GUI with a visual commit graph and hunk-level staging

description.p: BranchPilot is a desktop git client built around the git command-line tool: no libgit2 and no native git bindings. It never handles or stores credentials; git does that, with your ssh-agent and git configuration.

It shows a lane-based commit graph with colour-coded branch, tag and remote decorations, hunk-level diff staging with syntax highlighting, a commit and amend box, branch and stash management, merge conflict resolution, fetch, pull and push with live progress, a visual interactive rebase with conflict pause and resume, tags, cherry-pick, revert, a confirmation-gated hard reset, worktrees and per-file history.
The Flatpak carries its own git, which runs inside the sandbox and reads your ~/.gitconfig and ~/.config/git.
